memory_candidates.content: paper-definitions-of-record.md has a documented, precedent-backed convention: adding a manifest row for a previously LIVE-UNPINNED anchor (a coverage extension) must NOT bump the whole-file FILE_CHECKSUM/PINNED_COMMIT sentinels -- only a drift CORRECTION of an already-pinned anchor does that. Bumping on every coverage extension would turn the sentinel into a diary of touch-events. See the file's own 2026-08-13 22-anchor coverage-extension precedent (line 41) before re-pinning on any similar pin-a-new-anchor task.

When a grep-based citation-drift sweep is scoped to files the dispatch names 'by example' plus a broader directory sweep, do not trust the example set's file list as exhaustive -- in task 626, PlusNonValidities.lean and PlusStateLocal.lean carried 7 of 15 total drifted citations despite not being named as examples in the dispatch. Always run the full directory-level grep before writing the report's inventory table.
